title: One document-transfer deadline for every upload and download
evidence: packages/health-core/src/transfer-deadline.ts: every cloud call reads its bound from it (call 30 s, document 300 s, token refresh 5 s, account email 10 s, Drive scaled upload); Drive and Dropbox document downloads at 300 s, cosmetic Drive calls at 30 s, all four document uploads carry the may-have-landed hint (US-09 AC51). The two exchange bounds stay at their one call site each; the local-file race went to state lead U15
